name: Friar Olaf

source.note: The 2024 Cultist Fanatic (2025 Monster Manual). Every number compared with the page fetched from aidedd.org (Monster Manual 2024 stat block). Spiritual Weapon is entered both in the spell list (2/day) and as the Bonus Action.

summary: A friar who preaches and smiles. Struck down, he rises as a Night Creature at full strength.

phases.name: Night Creature
phases.summary: The man falls, and rises at full strength in the shape of a Night Creature, Large and clawed.

actions_add.name: Multiattack
actions_add.summary: One Claw attack and a Bite.

actions_add.name: Claw
actions_add.summary: +6, 1d6+4 Slashing; a Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 14).

actions_add.name: Bite
actions_add.summary: One willing, Grappled, Incapacitated or Restrained creature within 5 ft, DC 14 Con save: 1d4+4 Piercing plus 2d6 Necrotic; its Hit Point maximum drops by the Necrotic damage and the night creature heals that much.

traits_add.name: Blood Stalker
traits_add.summary: Advantage on Wisdom checks to find or track a creature that is missing any Hit Points.
traits_add.text: The night creature has Advantage on Wisdom checks made to locate or follow a creature that has lost any Hit Points.

traits_add.name: Salt Susceptibility
traits_add.summary: Vulnerable to damage from a weapon wiped with salt (a Bonus Action; it lasts 1 minute or until the weapon hits a creature).
traits_add.text: The night creature has Vulnerability to damage from weapons wiped with salt. A creature can use a Bonus Action to wipe salt onto a weapon; it stays coated for 1 minute or until it hits a creature.

traits_add.name: Spider Climb
traits_add.summary: Climbs walls and ceilings with no ability check.
traits_add.text: The night creature can climb difficult surfaces, ceilings included, without an ability check.

traits_add.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits_add.summary: Takes 20 Radiant if it starts its turn in sunlight; in sunlight, Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
traits_add.text: The night creature takes 20 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight, and while in sunlight it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks. (Druskenvald has no sun: this fires only against Daylight, Sunbeam and the like.)
